content: MK says the primary purpose of this narrative is to show himself, for Shāhrukh's benefit, an implacable opponent of messianic and antinomian Sufism in all its guises, yet that its raw, outraged tone also shows he blamed the crippling of his lettrist project on both mercenary messiahs and insecure, reactionary schoolmen, Sufis and otherwise, and the Hurufis above all.
refers_to_primary: MK's reading of the second apology
